exposure: Gynaecological pathologies (adenomyosis, endometriosis, leiomyomas, haemorrhagic ovarian cyst, tubo-ovarian abscess, pelvic inflammatory disease)
outcome: Emergency Department visits for gynaecological disturbances
cohort: 461 consecutive women of reproductive age (18 to < postmenopausal) who visited the emergency department for gynaecological disturbances at the University Hospital of Modena.
finding: Chronic gynaecological pathologies such as adenomyosis, endometriosis, and leiomyomas significantly impacted the use of the emergency department, with adenomyosis being the most common pathology regardless of age.
